lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Channels: frontier lanes threaded between asteroid belts and nebula banks. Day 41 out of Harrow Yard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The survey cutter Kestrel flies home to Meridian Station with three escorts: Finch, Wren and Kite.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The scout Sparrow rides in its cradle. Its pilot, Teo Marsh, has Kestrel's helm today.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Channel Nine, Captain. Narrowest lane on the chart, and nobody ever bothered to name it. I'm calling it the Throat.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Please don't.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Too late. It's in the log.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Finch to Kestrel. Holding escort position. Probably. Captain, is my spacing right? It looks wrong from here.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Your spacing is perfect, Nanda. It was perfect the last four times you asked.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Right. Good. Great. Captain... permission to panic?

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Denied. Captains panic in private. You have your own cabin now. Use it.

lines.speaker: wren_pilot
lines.text: Sefa here. I panicked through my whole first command, Nanda. Still brought the ship home. Mostly the same shape.

lines.speaker: kite_pilot
lines.text: Dov here. Can confirm. It was a different shape.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Noted. Finch will panic quietly, privately and in formation.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Helm's steady. For the record, I'd also like permission to panic. This ship is four times bigger than mine.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Denied, Teo. Nobody panics on my bridge before lunch.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Oh, and a packet came in on the Meridian relay. Personal. I didn't read it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: ...I read the header.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Vey. Halcyon's out on a courier run, but I'll be back on station before you dock. Don't you dare take the long way.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: See you at Meridian.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: (quietly) See you at Meridian.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Captain, you're smiling. I can hear it over comms.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Eyes on the lane, Finch. All escorts: run the buoys. Let's get home.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Finch copies. First command, first lane. Let's get home.
